reviews.title: Absolute Scam – Do Not Trust Tag Mobile
reviews.text:
Absolute Scam – Do Not Trust Tag Mobile
Tag Mobile confirmed via email that they were sending me a G7 phone through the Lifeline program for low-income families, but instead, they shipped a completely defective tablet. When I reached out to customer service to fix their error, they refused to send an exchange or even provide a return shipping label for the broken item they sent me.
This program is meant to help struggling families access essential communication, yet Tag Mobile is blatantly taking advantage of people and delivering useless, broken hardware. Since they refuse to take responsibility or fix their mistake, I am filing a formal complaint and reaching out to my local representative to report their business practices. Avoid this company at all costs.
